def line_runs(cells):
    """Group cells into lines of length >= 2 sharing a row or a column: (lines, horizontal)."""
    from collections import defaultdict
    byrow=defaultdict(list); bycol=defaultdict(list)
    for i,j in cells: byrow[i].append(j); bycol[j].append(i)
    rr={i:sorted(v) for i,v in byrow.items() if len(v)>=2}
    cc={j:sorted(v) for j,v in bycol.items() if len(v)>=2}
    if len(rr)==2 and len(cc)!=2:
        return [[(i,j) for j in rr[i]] for i in sorted(rr)], True
    if len(cc)==2 and len(rr)!=2:
        return [[(i,j) for i in cc[j]] for j in sorted(cc)], False
    return None, None

    """Two parallel marker runs and seed cells: each seed beams toward its run's cell (seed becomes `junction`),
    and the other run's cell at the same offset beams across the full line; both beams take the seed's color."""

    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
